title: ENS Events
tagline: ENS debugger tool to see what happened to your ENS name and when it happened
description:
ENS debugger tool to see what happened to your ENS name and when it happened

- Events happened to the name (Registrar, Resolver, and Controller)
- Complete details about the name
- Records set for the name
- Available wallets
- Domain names and subdomains owned list
- Grace period warnings
how_its_made:
Tech stack used and its explanations



- Next.js (Frontend and Serverless APIs)

- Tailwind CSS for styling and design utils

- The Graph Protocol for fetching ENS data and search data

- Rivet Cloud for ETH RPC which is very fast

- Eth.xyz for wallet records API

- Ethers.js to fetch data on-chain and for some util functions

- Jazzicons for address avatars
